title: Fake colour test: you vs mantis shrimp
storyboard: Film: adult friend takes a fake colour test with paint swatches; result card reveal and real reaction
caption:
12 colour receptors, and still lost to my friend.

Some mantis shrimp have 12 photoreceptor types spanning deep ultraviolet to far red, roughly 300 to 720 nanometres.

Source: Thoen et al. 2014, Science.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
